items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...classical guitar, the Spanish guitar players like Segovia and all...

ctx.x: No, I have a Carl Fisher's book, alright, but it's nothing.

I'm going to ask you if you ever did any picking with your fingers, you know, like the classical guitar, the Spanish guitar players like Segovia and all, where they'll pick, you know, where they'll pick with all of their, about three fingers and their thumb, or if you just always used the pick to strum it, what style of guitar?

Well, I did, but I wasn't too successful with it. I think I waited a little too late for that. So you've always used the pick? I've always used the pick. The pick style. I would like to study it, but if I had, you know, time to put it into it. Maybe I could, you know, do a little stuff. Did you, uh, like the guitar.
